matched.title: immediateDelete cancels the SendGrid batch but leaves the WorkflowReminder row behind

results.judgeReason: Finding #2 points at emailReminderManager.ts and says that on the immediateDelete path the helper returns right after the SendGrid cancel, so the WorkflowReminder row is never deleted or updated. That is the same root cause as the known bug: the database cleanup is missing when immediateDelete is true. It also explains the impact: orphaned rows that point at a cancelled batch, and duplicate cancels sent by the cron. Findings #0 and #1 describe different problems (dropped awaits, and the loop aborting on one error).
